sentences: Fixture Badger is a threat actor that abuses cloud administrator accounts to gain and keep access to cloud environments.
Current detections do not cover this activity: of the 1 technique identified, none are covered, none are partially covered, and 1 is a gap.
One draft hunt has been written to look for Additional Cloud Credentials (T1098.001), and it is waiting for analyst review, with nothing deployed until an analyst approves it.
